sections.text:
Professional Summary
1. Senior Contact Center Engineer with 15+ years of experience designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise contact center solutions.
2. Associated with American Express since April 2019, progressing from UCCE Engineer (Infrastructure & Application) to Senior Infrastructure Engineer. Seasoned Contact Center Engineer with extensive experience across Genesys Cloud, Genesys Pure Engage, and Cisco UCCE platforms, specializing in user onboarding, platform configuration, application support, infrastructure management, and ensuring high availability, scalability, stability, and performance of enterprise contact center environments.
3. Worked with Tata Consultancy Services from May 2011 to March 2019 as a Contact Center Engineer, specializing in UCCE ICM scripting, Avaya ACD Call flow designing, and carrier routing tools including AT&T IT Business Direct and BT Firebird for toll-free number configuration. 4. Worked with Migital Technovation for 11 months as an Android Application Developer, contributing to mobile app design and development.

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
Professional Experience
Genesys Cloud User Migration & Platform Onboarding Managed end-to-end migration activities from Genesys Pure Engage to Genesys Cloud CX, including TFN/DID procurement, telephony provisioning, and carrier coordination for seamless number onboarding. Configured inbound routing, queues, user profiles, permissions, and access management to enable smooth user onboarding and operational readiness. Designed and implemented Architect call flows and call handling logic aligned with business requirements. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure successful deployment, platform stability, and a seamless transition of contact center operations to the cloud environment.
Cloud Transformation of Voice Biometrics Platform (Nuance Security Suite to Gatekeeper SaaS) Led platform-side execution of the first-of-its-kind cloud migration of Voice Biometrics solution to SaaS Gatekeeper across two regions, delivering a phased rollout with zero downtime. Managed multi-region infrastructure build, ACL enablement, load balancer configuration, System integration testing, patching & certificate lifecycle management (for On Prem servers), and end-to-end Disaster Recovery planning and execution.
Genesys Engage Application Stack upgrade Lead the comprehensive planning, coordination, execution, and post-implementation validation of application stack upgrades within the on-premises Genesys Engage environment. Own the upgrade lifecycle for core components including SIP Feature Server (SIP FS), Stat Server, SIP Server, SIP Proxy, RM, MRCP Proxy application servers. Responsibilities include conducting impact assessments, defining upgrade strategy and rollback plans, coordinating with cross-functional infrastructure and business teams, and ensuring alignment with change management processes. Oversee environment readiness activities such as dependency validation, compatibility checks, configuration backups, and capacity planning. Execute upgrades in development, QA, and production environments, ensuring adherence to high availability and minimal downtime requirements.
Customer Call path and CCP migration from UCCE & Avaya to Genesys Lead multiple Customer call flow and user migration programs from Cisco UCCE and Avaya to Genesys Engage. Owned end-to-end onboarding configuration on GA/GAX, including folder hierarchy design, access group, role provisioning and ringfencing to restrict permission, virtual agent groups, skills and business attributes. Configured NRRC code logic, corporate favourite, ensuring standardized routing, secure access control, and smooth production onboarding.
During user migration activities, designed and implemented standardized roles and access groups within Genesys to enable reuse of configuration objects. This rationalized permissions, prevented duplication of similar objects, and reduced configuration server load while improving maintainability and onboarding speed.
Legacy UCCE Retirement Program

Led the decommissioning of Cisco UCCE infrastructure (Central Controllers – Router/Logger, Peripheral Gateways, AW/HDS/DDS, CTI components, and SQL databases), ensuring complete traffic drain-down and controlled shutdown of services.
Performed deep call flow and routing analysis (ICM scripts, dialed numbers, call types, historical and real-time metrics) to identify call traffic landing on UCCE system.
Designed and executed the migration strategy to Genesys, translating UCCE routing logic into Genesys routing/queue configurations, and managing phased traffic cutover with validation.
Managed cross-functional execution end-to-end, partnered with network, voice, and business teams to reconfigure call flows, with disruption and formally decommission UCCE servers in compliance with change governance.
Global Cisco UCCE Infrastructure Migration & Platform Modernization
Migrated ~40 UCCE VMs from third-party hosting to in-house data centers; owned migration sequencing, IP re-addressing, AW rebuilds, vendor coordination, and zero-downtime cutover execution.
Relocated multi-site ACD Peripheral Gateway (PG) pairs across data centers using parallel builds and controlled traffic cutovers; streamlined integrations with Avaya ACD, CTI portals, and recording platforms.
Virtualized and upgraded 20+ global ACD PG pairs (UCCE 9.4 → 10.5) from bare metal to Cisco OVA-based VMs; led lab validation, dependency alignment, integration testing, and production rollout.
Modernized Central Controller custom DB integration by upgrading external SQL Server (2008 → 2016); provisioned new Windows 2012 VM, executed data migration, secured named-account connectivity, validated in lab, and delivered seamless production cutover.
